description:
action="list" lists approved account publications; action="get" reads one account publication.

Set "action" to choose the operation. Only send the fields listed for that action.

## action="list": List public Marketplace accounts
No other fields required.
Lists approved account publications. Strategy identities and broker account identifiers are never included. Performance fields remain absent unless the owner explicitly granted them.

## action="get": Read a permission-filtered Marketplace account
Required fields: publicationId.
Returns account performance, positions, and verified filled trades only when each capability was explicitly granted. Exact quantities are separately permissioned. Broker account and credential identifiers are never returned.

action.description: Which operation to run: "list", "get". See the tool description for each one.

publicationId.description: Used with action="get". Required for action="get".
